notes: Full native, all four complete/enlarged specimens and full/enlarged actual Regular inspected. Native retains THX detached paired top forks, open left roof, middle crossbar and outer legs, but upper inner Y stem wrongly continues down into lower interior, stopping free above L baseline. Coherent THX upper Y crosses middle bar then bends right into outer right descending leg; a separate short lower inner upright begins below middle bar with a gap and joins the inner L baseline. Actual tracing retains both incorrect upper/lower flow and missing L-base contact.
